# G02 fixture profiles

Format and rules: `docs/g02/slice-contract.md` §2. All hosts use the reserved
`.invalid`/`.internal`/`example` names; nothing here is a real destination.

| File | Expected result |
|---|---|
| `homelab.toml` | `PROFILE_OK`, 3 destinations, port default applied to `nas` |
| `large-100.toml` | `PROFILE_OK`, 100 destinations (generated by `gen_large.py`) |
| `spaced dir ü/prøfile homelab.toml` | `PROFILE_OK`, identical data to `homelab.toml` |
| `invalid-forbidden-key.toml` | exit 2 `SCHEMA_INVALID`; `HEIMDALL_CANARY_` value must not appear anywhere |
| `invalid-unknown-dest-key.toml` | exit 2 `SCHEMA_INVALID`, key path `destinations[0].identity_file` (or equivalent) |
| `invalid-malformed.toml` | exit 2 `SCHEMA_INVALID` |
| `invalid-schema-version.toml` | exit 2 `SCHEMA_INVALID` |
| `invalid-duplicate-alias.toml` | exit 2 `SCHEMA_INVALID` |
| `invalid-port.toml` | exit 2 `SCHEMA_INVALID` |
| `oversize.toml` | created by the harness at run time (>1 MiB) → exit 2 `INPUT_TOO_LARGE` |
